convert_hf_model_to_fp8: convert a HuggingFace safetensors model directory to FP8 quantized format for efficient inference
quantize_weights_block: quantize a PyTorch weight tensor to FP8 using per-block quantization with configurable block dimensions
quantize_weights_channel: quantize a PyTorch weight tensor to FP8 using per-channel quantization along the last dimension
quantize_weights_tensor: quantize a PyTorch weight tensor to FP8 using global tensor-level quantization
process_safetensors_files: process HuggingFace safetensors files in parallel to convert weights to FP8 with configurable strategy and block size
